title: Notch Focus HUD
brief: Show macOS Focus changes in the notch of a MacBook: which Focus turned on or off, with its icon and color, animated in the same wings as the volume and brightness HUD, keeping the camera area empty

artboards.title: Announce wings
artboards.tradeoff: Matches the volume HUD exactly; after 1.6 s nothing shows that a Focus is still on

artboards.title: Persistent badge
artboards.tradeoff: Shows the active Focus at a glance all the time; adds one more element to the compact row and keeps the notch visible during a Focus
